title: nCHANT #01
subtitle: On Digital Gardens
abstract: nCHANT is REINCANTAMENTO’s new monographic magazine — an oblique optical device for exploring unusual ideas, a polyphonic, anti-disciplinary chorus of voices examining concepts at the membrane between culture and technology.
intro: nCHANT is REINCANTAMENTO’s new monographic magazine. As an oblique optical device for exploring unusual ideas, nCHANT represents a polyphonic, anti-disciplinary chorus of voices examining concepts at the membrane between culture and technology.
nCHANT’s inaugural issue, “On Digital Gardens”, expands and situates the concept of digital garden: symbolic spaces that embody the desire for a post-capitalist Internet.

Digital gardens represent realms for autonomous knowledge organization and self-expression, elements that commercial platforms continue to short-circuit. They function as fields of seeded ideas and unfinished thoughts, waiting for their time to flourish, die, and be born again. A wilder, more personal Web waiting to be rediscovered.
sections: This 92-page publication features a research report based on interviews with 20+ practitioners from the Trust community in Berlin, alongside thoughts on fractal software structures, practical guides for creating self-hosted digital gardens, philosophical dialogue on desire, and spatial analyses of garden environments.
Dimensions 176 × 250 mm. 92 pages. ISSN 3052-1556. Graphic design by Giorgio Craparo, printed by SkillPress in Venice, Italy. Funded by the Trust Community.
availability: Released May 17, 2025 in a limited run of 50. Not available.

title: Arcane Affinities
subtitle: Esoteric Algorithms & Re-Enchanted Technologies
abstract: Arcane Affinities brings together two international exhibitions, gathering artworks and essays that explore how esoteric practices can reactivate agency and technological imagination.
intro: Arcane Affinities is a catalogue bridging two exhibitions — Esoteric Algorithms and Re-Enchanted Technologies at Panke Gallery (Berlin) and Esoteric Ecotechnics at MFRU 25 (Maribor).

Mapping the edges of hermetic practices, Arcane Affinities gathers artworks, essays, and experimental methods exploring how esoteric thinking can restore agency. The catalogue is co-published with servus.at, the legendary Linz-based platform for net culture and critical digital practice.
credits: Linz-based platform for net culture and critical digital practice
sections: Dimensions 170 × 240 mm. 68 pages, staple binding. ISBN 978-3-9504200-4-3. Graphic design by Giorgio Craparo, digitally printed by SkillPress, Venice, Italy. Typeset with Ortica Linear and Jacquard 12, on Fedrigoni Materica Terra Gialla 250g and Arena Natural Rough 100g. Co-published with servus.at.
availability: Released November 18, 2025 in a limited run of 20, at $15 plus $5 shipping. Sold out.
